To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the efficacy of discriminant analysis (classifier) performance measures is not well understood, and we provide a set of criteria to help researchers select performance measures that are more relevant to end user needs.
the most common measures for discriminant analysis do not provide end users with the information they need.
the eight summary statistics considered do not meet end users’ criteria for efficacy and two new criteria-compliant measures are proposed and demonstrated to be useful to end users.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the efficacy of discriminant analysis measures for end users and the results show that researchers can make the test outcomes more relevant for the end users by making minor changes in their analysis and presentation.
making discriminant analysis more end user efficacious.
the efficacy of discriminant analysis (DA) measures for end users.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
end users are best off with the two criteria-compliant measures.
the proposed criteria-compliant measures can be used to provide more end-user efficacious discriminant analysis results.
the proposed criteria are a necessary condition for a summary statistics to be end user efficacious, but not a sufficient condition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the efficacy of a measure is a function of both the user and the problem.
end users should be able to understand the results and make decisions based on those results.
the proposed summary statistics can be used to provide more relevant information to end users.
The main takeaway from our work is that
researchers should consider the needs of end users when they report results.
the efficacy of discriminant analysis (classifier) measures should be assessed by end users, not by researchers.
researchers should be more aware of end users’ needs and provide them with more relevant and useful information.
